# couchbase-capella-aidp_providers (Data Source)

Lists AI Data Plane provider integrations for an organization. Optionally filter by `provider_type` (`awsS3`, `openAI`, `awsBedrock`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_providers" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  provider_type   = "openAI"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.

### Optional

- `provider_type` (String) Optional filter for provider type. Valid values: `awsS3`, `openAI`, `awsBedrock`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) The list of AI Data Plane provider integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Attributes) Couchbase audit data for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--audit))
- `configuration` (String) JSON object containing the provider-specific configuration.
- `id` (String) The ID of the provider integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the provider integration.
- `type` (String) The type of provider. One of `awsS3`, `openAI`, `awsBedrock`.
